title: 4. Wax-Wax Fruit (Doru Doru no Mi)
facts: Fruit look from the user's oparchive screenshots (refs/batch3/DESIGNS.md)

plan.fruit: Drawn from the design you sent (refs/batch3).

lines.text: You take a bite#red of a weird dripping white#purple fruit.
lines.say: You take a bite of a weird dripping white fruit.

lines.text: Don't panic,#red that's just a Devil#purple Fruit.#purple
lines.say: Don't panic, that's just a Devil Fruit.

lines.text: Out of every fruit in the sea,#blue
lines.say: Out of every fruit in the sea,

lines.text: a Paramecia#orange that lets you make wax as hard as steel.#gold
lines.say: a Paramecia that lets you make wax as hard as steel.

lines.text: First, you shape wax into walls, swords#pink and shields.#purple
lines.say: First, you shape wax into walls, swords and shields.

lines.text: Then you trap#red people's#blue feet in wax so they can't move.
lines.say: Then you trap people's feet in wax so they can't move.

lines.text: You can even make a giant#orange wax suit and fight from inside#pink it.
lines.say: You can even make a giant wax suit and fight from inside it.

lines.text: Your strongest#blue trick is the Candle Service#gold Set: a cake that slowly turns people into wax statues.
lines.say: Your strongest trick is the Candle Service Set: a cake that slowly turns people into wax statues.

lines.text: But wax has one big weakness.#gold
lines.say: But wax has one big weakness.

lines.text: Mr. 3 of Baroque#gold Works#red used it, until Usopp lit his wax on fire.
lines.say: Mr. 3 of Baroque Works used it, until Usopp lit his wax on fire.

lines.text: Users of this fruit never run out of candles.#purple
lines.say: Users of this fruit never run out of candles.

lines.text: Which fruit#pink do you want next?#gold Follow for more.
lines.say: Which fruit do you want next? Follow for more.
